result.title: BtsPruner: Role-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Large Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) often process hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, resulting in substantial computational and memory overhead during inference. Existing training-free pruning methods typically estimate token importance using language-model attention, visual attention, or feature similarity. However, these methods treat visual tokens with uniform criteria and overlook that tokens may serve different roles during visual encoding. In this work, we investigate the evolution of visual token roles in LVLMs and observe that tokens progressively transition from local detail carriers to globally referenced representatives as encoding proceeds. Based on this observation, we propose BtsPruner, a training-free role-aware visual token pruning framework that preserves complementary token roles under a fixed budget. Specifically, BtsPruner first identifies the token-role transition point based on the evolution of attention concentration. It then discovers globally referenced representatives from later encoding stages and recursively retrieves local detail tokens from earlier stages to recover complementary fine-grained evidence. Extensive experiments across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, Qwen-VL, InternVL, and CogVLM demonstrate that BtsPruner achieves superior performance retention under aggressive token reduction. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, BtsPruner preserves 91.6% of the dense model's performance using only 32 of 576 visual tokens (5.6%). In the high-resolution LLaVA-NeXT-7B setting, it achieves up to a 5.95x CUDA-latency speedup.

AI.brief_summary: 该文观察到 LVLM 编码过程中视觉 token 由「局部细节载体」逐步过渡为「全局被引用代表」，据此提出免训练的角色感知剪枝框架 BtsPruner：先依注意力集中度演化定位角色转变点，再从后期阶段选取全局代表并递归回溯早期阶段取回局部细节 token，在固定预算下保留互补角色，并在多个 LVLM 上验证激进剪枝下的性能保持与加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「角色转变点＋细节/代表互补保留」的选取策略，可供核查固定视觉 token 预算下细粒度证据如何被保留或丢失，可能与 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选、视觉旁路与信息坍缩问题相关；但该方法面向推理效率而非推理过程，联系为潜在借鉴。
